plugins.name: cc-desktop-statusline
plugins.description: A status band above the Claude Code prompt with context use, plan limits, API-equivalent cost and a monthly activity grid.

plugins.name: pixel-pet
plugins.description: A herd of pixel-art pets in the band above the prompt that react to your session: they cheer after a turn, grow rounder as the context fills, nap under a futon once the prompt cache goes cold, and a beckoning figurine offers /compact. The band opens on the status band; a switch turns to the pets.

plugins.name: pixel-pet-dog
plugins.description: A pet pack for pixel-pet: a floppy-eared puppy (/pet dog). Also the example to copy for a pack of your own.
